constraints: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(n.nspname||'.'||r.relname||'.'||c.conname,jsonb_build_array(pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid),c.convalidated)),'{}')from pg_constraint c join pg_class r on r.oid=c.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=r.relnamespace where n.nspname in('public','family_auth')
policies: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(schemaname||'.'||tablename||'.'||policyname,to_jsonb(x)),'{}')from pg_policies x where schemaname in('public','family_auth')
triggers: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(n.nspname||'.'||r.relname||'.'||t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)),'{}')from pg_trigger t join pg_class r on r.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=r.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal and n.nspname in('public','family_auth')
table_grants: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||grantee||'.'||privilege_type,to_jsonb(x)-'table_catalog'),'{}')from information_schema.role_table_grants x where table_schema in('public','family_auth')and grantee in('anon','authenticated','service_role')
column_grants: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||column_name||'.'||grantee||'.'||privilege_type,to_jsonb(x)-'table_catalog'),'{}')from information_schema.column_privileges x where table_schema in('public','family_auth')and grantee in('anon','authenticated','service_role')
default_acl: select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole)||'.'||coalesce(n.nspname,'*')||'.'||d.defaclobjtype::text,to_jsonb(d.defaclacl)),'{}')from pg_default_acl d left join pg_namespace n on n.oid=d.defaclnamespace
